title: Luxe Haven! Pool, Sauna, Golf, Theatre & Games!
description:
Welcome to Luxe Haven – Glendale’s Premier Resort-Style Escape! Your own private luxury retreat designed for large groups, families, and unforgettable getaways! 

Luxury meets entertainment at this 7-bedroom Glendale home featuring a heated pool, spa, putting green, sauna, outdoor theater, gym, game room with arcades, billiards, shuffleboard, ping pong, foosball, corn hole, basketball throw and more. A perfect large-group escape minutes from Westgate and State Farm Stadium.
